fix-engine-tool-response.description: Fix AgentEngine._tool_call_with_bind() to return natural language + tool results, not raw JSON. The chat action in views.py calls this method and returns the raw JSON when tools are used. Must extract tool name, parameters, and results, then synthesize a natural language response.

fix-url-nested-routes.description: Fix conversation detail route in AgentConversationViewSet. The current routes conflict with AgentViewSet: /api/v1/agents/conversations/ (list) vs /api/v1/agents/{pk}/ (detail). Fix the nested routes so conversations/{id}/messages/ works correctly with UUID pks. Also verify /api/v1/agents/conversations/?agent_id=X works.

fix-chat-response-format.description: Fix the chat action in AgentViewSet to return natural language response in 'response' field, not raw tool call JSON. The frontend useAgent composable expects response.response or response.message. Backend should always return {success, response, tool_calls} format.

fix-frontend-api-alignment.description: Review and fix frontend-backend API alignment. Check: 1) Frontend API calls match backend endpoints. 2) Request/response formats match serializers. 3) Error handling is consistent. Focus on agent.js API, useAgent composable, and agent stores. Fix any mismatched endpoints or field names.

fix-stream-chat-endpoint.description: Check if /agents/{id}/stream_chat/ endpoint exists in AgentViewSet. The frontend useAgent composable calls this endpoint but it likely doesn't exist. Implement stream_chat action using Django StreamingHttpResponse with SSE format.

fix-dead-code-backend.description: Remove dead code in Backend/agents/. Check for: 1) Unused imports. 2) Unused functions/methods. 3) Commented-out code blocks. 4) Duplicate code. 5) Unreachable code. Focus on views.py, engine.py, serializers.py, multi_agent.py, and models.py.

fix-dead-code-frontend.description: Remove dead code in Frontend/src/. Check for: 1) Unused imports. 2) Unused functions/methods. 3) Commented-out code blocks. 4) Unused variables. Focus on agent.js, agent stores, useAgent.js, and Vue components under views/agent/.

fix-hardcoded-values.description: Find and fix hardcoded values across the entire project. Look for: 1) Hardcoded API URLs/ports. 2) Hardcoded model names (e.g. 'gpt-3.5-turbo'). 3) Hardcoded timeouts. 4) Hardcoded strings needing i18n. 5) Hardcoded feature flags. Extract to config files, constants, or environment variables.

fix-code-quality.description: Fix code quality issues: 1) Inconsistent naming (snake_case vs camelCase). 2) Missing error handling. 3) TODO/FIXME comments that should be resolved. 4) Inconsistent code style. 5) Missing type hints where beneficial. 6) Magic numbers/strings. Apply consistent patterns across backend and frontend.

fix-model-defaults.description: Fix Agent model default values. The model has hardcoded default_llm='gpt-3.5-turbo' which is not available (system uses Ollama). Set sensible defaults: default_llm='qwen2.5-coder:7b', temperature=0.7, max_tokens=2048, streaming=True. Also check AgentTool model for hardcoded values.

fix-conversation-uuid-pk.description: Fix UUID primary key handling in AgentConversationViewSet. The conversation model uses UUID pk but the routes may not properly handle UUID format. Verify that GET /api/v1/agents/conversations/{uuid}/ and GET /api/v1/agents/conversations/{uuid}/messages/ work correctly with UUID values.

fix-multiagent-integration.description: Review multi_agent.py integration. The file defines MultiAgentOrchestrator, SequentialPipeline, ParallelExecutor but may not be wired into the AgentEngine. Check if multi-agent features are actually usable through the API. Wire them up if missing or document them properly.

fix-security-auth.description: Security audit of Agent module: 1) Verify all endpoints have proper IsAuthenticated checks. 2) Check for SQL injection risks in queryset filters. 3) Verify file upload paths are sandboxed. 4) Check API rate limiting. 5) Verify CORS settings. 6) Check for sensitive data in logs.

fix-performance.description: Performance review: 1) Check database queries for N+1 problems in Agent views. 2) Verify select_related/prefetch_related are used where needed. 3) Check for blocking I/O in views. 4) Verify streaming responses work for large outputs. 5) Check LLM timeout configurations.
